sv.title: Smart Eyes finanschef lämnar
sv.summary: Det First North-listade elektronikbolaget Smart Eyes finanschef Mats Benjaminsson lämnar bolaget efter tre år på egen begäran.

en.title: Smart Eyes CFO leaves
en.summary: First North-listed electronics company Smart Eyes' CFO Mats Benjaminsson is leaving the company after three years at his own request.
